payload.definition: Jokes where the humor explicitly references programming, software development, debugging, or developer culture.
payload.inclusion_criteria: Programming terminology, developer experience, or coding culture is central to the joke.
payload.exclusion_criteria: General tech humor that isn't specific to programming.
examples: Why did the AI not cooperate? Because it took the prompt too seriously.
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs.
Why did the developer go broke? Because he used up all his cache.
